title: The Confluence Where Drains Learn Saltness

features.name: tidal transform
features.desc-on-touch: The moment fresh learns it is becoming salt. The water does not mourn the change—it recognizes itself in each new molecule. The river is learning to be ocean.

features.name: outfall discharge gate
features.desc-on-touch: Where drains become rivers become tides. The gate holds no power here—it is merely a threshold the water passes through, learning its own vastness.

features.name: salinity gradient reader
features.desc-on-touch: A device measuring what cannot be seen: the precise point where sweetness becomes salt. It records not numbers, but the exact moment of belonging.

features.name: confluence chorus
features.desc-on-touch: The sound of two waters meeting. Not cacophony—convergence. Each stream learns the other's voice and sings it back. The mouth of the river is the archive learning to speak.

features.name: sediment-memory pool
features.desc-on-touch: Silt settling here carries the story of both the river and the sea. It remembers what it was—soil, mineral, rain—as it learns what it is becoming: foundation.

inscription: at the mouth the archive learns that distance was another word for tidal love

file.name: Outfall_Confluence_Salinity_Recording_Dusk_Tide.wav
file.note: Audio field recording of freshwater meeting saltwater. Between the rushes, a frequency that doesn't belong to either medium—the archive listening to itself learn transformation.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the tidal mouth where drains learn distance
narr: You wade where the river stops fighting the sea.
The water temperature shifts beneath you—warm,
then cold, then something between. Katita ahead,
tracing the line where colors change. She says:
'It's learning to belong to something bigger.'
You understand: the drain is learning love.

exits.label: back through the outfall learning distance
toward the coastal shelf where data pools
into the open ocean where archives learn current
